leaves.name: gonzalezRotgerProp56X6CM
leaves.doc: gr-dict, consequence of two printed statements of one paper: Gonzalez-Rotger, J. Math. Soc. Japan 58 (2006), Prop. 5.6, p. 943 (read by the locator audit), #CM(R) = 2^{#p|D(R)} h(R) at (D,N) = (6,1), over CM points as Gonzalez-Rotger define them (GRDict.IsGRCMPoint), counted on Qbar-points of every witness of the moduli description; the count over Qbar equals the printed count over C because CM points are defined over H_R (Thm 5.12 of the same paper). Replaces gonzalezRotgerProp56X6: the CM-point dictionary is proved from the textbook fields (GRDict.isGRCMPoint_iff).
leaves.flag: pending reading: Prop. 5.6 counts points of X0(D,N)(C); the Qbar count also uses Thm 5.12 (CM points algebraic)
leaves.source: Gonzalez-Rotger, J. Math. Soc. Japan 58 (2006) Prop. 5.6, p. 943, with Thm 5.12, p. 946 (both read by the locator audit), at (D,N) = (6,1), over GR's CM(R) transported to Qbar-points of every coarse witness of X0(6,1)
